headline: ICE raids Gallatin County sites, with as many as 100 detained
summary: ICE conducted targeted immigration enforcement operations across Gallatin County, Montana, detaining over 100 individuals, including some with legal authorization. The raids were chaotic and unprofessional, leaving residents upset and fearful for immigrant families. ICE's lack of transparency made tracking detainees difficult; many were transferred rapidly between facilities. Local organizations offered assistance to immigrants and their families amidst community concern.
